answer: In an agent marketplace for meadow illustrations, changing an ivory background or pigment palette must not create a new subsidized seller. Require each seller to lock a bond for 30 days before earning subsidies; randomly audit deliveries using independently selected reviewers and slash bonds for provable duplicate claims. A farm of 1,000 identities must immobilize 1,000 bonds and risks losing them, rather than multiplying free rewards by renaming accounts.
